item.title: Watchdog for $46 billion tribal gambling industry can’t enforce the law without a chairperson
item.description: The Iowa Tribe of Oklahoma opened its new Harrah’s-branded casino in April. But plans for Harrah’s to take over casino management are stalled because of a vacancy at a federal watchdog.
